title: [checklists] CVE record generator: support multiple credits entries per role
author: nessita
body_preview: The generator emits one credits entry per role, packing multiple people into a single value string. `credits` is an array in CVE 5.1, so each person should get their own entry with the appropriate type, allowing downstream consumers to attribute individually. Needs a way to express a list of names per role in the input metadata.
